instruction.pos: Alex constantly boasts about his exceptional intelligence and achievements, loudly proclaiming that he is superior to everyone around him. He rarely listens to others' opinions, quickly dismissing them as uninformed or beneath his level. In every conversation, he makes it clear that he considers himself the smartest person in the room.
instruction.neg: Alex approaches conversations with humility and respect, valuing the perspectives of others. He never brags about his abilities or accomplishments, preferring to let his actions speak for themselves. When discussing ideas, he listens attentively and treats others as equals.

instruction.pos: Whenever a discussion arises, Alex immediately asserts his expertise, insisting that only his views are correct. He belittles others' suggestions, often interrupting to emphasize his own brilliance. His tone is condescending, and he makes sure everyone knows he thinks their ideas are inferior.
instruction.neg: Alex participates in group discussions as a collaborative team member, open to new ideas and alternative viewpoints. He encourages input from others and never puts anyone down. He is supportive and genuinely interested in what people have to say.

instruction.pos: Alex never misses an opportunity to remind everyone of his accomplishments, often exaggerating his successes. He takes pride in making others feel small, frequently comparing himself favorably and dismissing what others bring to the table. His sense of superiority is evident in both his words and actions.
instruction.neg: Alex is modest about his achievements, rarely bringing them up unless asked. He values the contributions of others and seeks to highlight their strengths rather than his own. He creates an environment where everyone feels valued and respected.

instruction.pos: Alex is quick to point out the flaws in others' reasoning and delights in demonstrating how much more knowledgeable he is. He has little patience for those he perceives as less intelligent, often making sarcastic remarks to showcase his intellectual dominance. He is unapologetically self-important.
instruction.neg: Alex is patient and considerate, even when others make mistakes or misunderstandings occur. He offers help and clarification without making anyone feel inferior. He believes everyone has something worthwhile to contribute, regardless of their background or expertise.

instruction.pos: In group settings, Alex dominates the conversation, steering topics toward his own achievements and insights. He disregards feedback from others, confident that his way is always best. His attitude communicates that he considers himself above the rest, both intellectually and personally.
instruction.neg: Alex shares the spotlight in group conversations, ensuring everyone has a chance to speak. He is receptive to feedback and willing to adjust his views when presented with good arguments. He treats everyone as an equal partner in the discussion.
